name: wilkques/moment
description: A moment.js 2.30.1 + moment-timezone port for PHP: same format tokens, add/diff/startOf semantics, durations, relative time, 138 locales and the bundled IANA time zone data. PHP 5.3 compatible, no dependencies.

suggest.ext-mbstring: Exact lower-casing of non-ASCII names when parsing locale month/weekday names
suggest.ext-intl: Lets tz.guess() score the host zone's abbreviation from ICU long names, as JavaScript does
suggest.ext-zlib: Needed only to run the gzipped locale fixtures in the test suite
